features: The download sheet now shows every server's file size for your chosen quality and language — one row per server, smallest first, so you can see that Server 10's 1080p file is 131 MB while Server 5's is ~369 MB and pick the one you want. Tap a row to download from that server first (the others still work as backup), or leave it on Auto
The sheet's download button now names the server you picked ("Download Episode 1 · Server 10") instead of just the episode
fixes: Fixed the sheet hiding the small file: it used to show only the winning server's size, so a much smaller file at the same quality went unnoticed. The size list is the server picker now — Auto, Smallest and Direct tags show which row Auto would download, which file is smallest, and which files are direct downloads
